source: US EPA Greenhouse Gas Equivalencies Calculator - Calculations and References
note: US averages used only to make a rough kg CO2e estimate easier to picture. They are illustrations, not measurements or offsets.

car_km.derivation: 3.93 x 10^-4 metric tons CO2e per mile (average gasoline passenger vehicle) / 1.609344 km per mile

phone_charge.derivation: 1.24 x 10^-5 metric tons CO2 per smartphone charged

tree_month.derivation: 0.060 metric ton CO2 per urban tree seedling per year (10-year average) / 12 months
